[PREFERENCE] User is interested in learning more about Dixit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed explanation of Dixit's mechanics, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The objective is for players to guess which card was chosen by the storyteller based on a single clue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The game includes 84 large illustrated cards, voting tokens, a scoreboard, and a rulebook.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gameplay involves storytelling, clue-giving, voting, revealing cards, and scoring.
